positioningSources.claimsVerbatim:
Clarifying and detoxifying shampoo to fight microbial attacks and dandruff to establish a healthy environment for hair growth. Hair and scalp are healthy, flake-free and deep cleansed without causing irritation.

Benefits: Shine Purifying Anti dandruff Cosmetic intensive treatment against dandruff. Quick resolution of flaking problems. Antioxidant action. Natural derived active ingredients.
positioningSources.directionsVerbatim: Apply 20 gr. of product to the scalp with damp hair and massage in, especially on those areas most affected. Leave on for a few minutes. Rinse off thoroughly. Intensive treatment: twice a week for maximum 3 weeks. Maintenance treatment: once a week for 6 weeks. The maintenance treatment can be interrupted earlier than 6 weeks if the problem has been resolved.
